# Marwane Haddane — Portfolio
> Cybersecurity Engineering Student & Full-Stack / AI Developer

## Overview
Marwane Haddane is a Cybersecurity Engineering student at ENSA Fés. Experienced in ethical hacking, automated threat scanning, machine learning, robotics, and modern web application development.

## Key Projects
- **WeSecure Platform**: Automated cybersecurity vulnerability scanner and phishing classifier (Python, n8n, Flask, ML).
- **Memoria**: Cloud-based Alzheimer patient monitoring platform with AI robot assistant (React, Raspberry Pi, LLaMA, SQLite).
- **AI Hub**: Experimental hub for ML models, natural language chatbots, and OpenCV computer vision.

## Certifications & Education
- State Engineering Degree in Cybersecurity — ENSA Fès (Class of 2028)
- Harvard CS50x (Computer Science)
- Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate
- DataCamp LLM Development
